correctness_confidence.basis: Exemplary formal verification of 18 algebraic and counting lemmas in Lean 4 with zero sorry and zero axioms of choice, combined with exact-Q rational instance verifications.

novelty.basis: Innovative dual-layer verification architecture uniting formal theorem proving with exact rational certificate auditing for multi-agent cake-cutting algorithms.

reproducibility.basis: Complete reproducibility with standalone Lean 4 modules, Python exact-Q verifiers, 16 canonical certificates, and SHA-256 artifact enforcement.

rigor.basis: Outstanding mathematical and computational rigor, rigorously checking Hall robustness, softmax weights, stability perturbations, and spanning-tree allocations.

significance.basis: Major contribution to formally verified algorithmic game theory and fair division, establishing solid guarantees for five-agent envy-free cake-cutting.

potential_errors: Minor notation density in tables, which is well-explained in accompanying text.
strengths: Exhaustive exact-rational instance checking across 16 canonical certificates and 60 adversarial forgeries.
strong_novelty_candidates: Dual-layer exact rational and Lean 4 verification stack for polylogarithmic envy-free cake cutting.
summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous, dual-layer verification framework for five-agent contiguous envy-free cake cutting under monotone Lipschitz valuations. It combines 18 formally verified lemmas in Lean 4 with an exact-rational instance verifier (EF-CAKE5-CERT-1.0), demonstrating complete correctness across 16 canonical certificates and 60 adversarial test cases.
weaknesses: Scope is intentionally restricted to algebraic and exact rational instance verification without formalizing continuous topologies inside Lean 4.
